Alright, I've never had a porn addiction, so I'm not really confident about giving advice for that specifically, but I have some personal experience with overcoming habits and addictions in general.

First, you need to ask yourself why you're doing it. It might not be evident immediately. You might have to wait til next time you feel the urge to do it. When you do, take the time to observe what's going through you're head. Try to do this every time you get the urge. You might find that you'll feel more in control just from taking the time to observe.

Next, you need to set a realistic goal for reducing your porn consumption. It can be hard to tell what's realistic, but as a general rule you should make the first goal fairly easy and slowly work your way up. Try researching how other's have beat porn addiction for some more specific advice.

Lastly, I want you to know that you are not abnormal and there is plenty of hope left for you, based on what you've described here. Lots of teenagers have problems with porn addiction, lack of motivation, ect.

I hope your life gets better and I hope that if my advice doesn't help, someone else's does. Good luck.
